Name: (OLD) Earthy Recolour map fix for Immersive Farm 2 Remastered (Unofficial)
Author: Xryzo11
Description:
[u][size=6][b]NO LONGER MAINTAINED, DOWNLOAD [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29941]THIS[/url]﻿ MOD INSTEAD[/b][/size][/u]

This mod fixes the incorrect seasonal grass and tree colors on the world map while using DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour on the Stardew Valley Expanded's Immersive Farm 2 Remastered.
Works with Stardew Valley 1.6

Installation (Content Patcher):
1. Copy the '[CP] DNER IF2R map fix' from inside the .zip file into the 'mods' folder
Hopefully it works

[s]Installation (outdated version):
1. Copy the .png files from 'this mod/WorldMaps'
2. Remove the original .png files from '[CP] Immersive Farm 2 Remastered/assets/maps/WorldMaps'
3. Paste the .png files you copied
4. In '[CP] DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour/config.json' set 'enableMiniMapRecolour' to 'true'[/s]

Other DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour minimaps:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21691]Stardew Valley Expanded fix[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21755]Grandpa's Farm fix[/url]

Maps for versions 1.6 and above were made using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21545]this[/url].
